meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 你说要审计设计时,Claude 会按迪特·拉姆斯的十项原则逐条给设计打分(0–3)并附证据,再判断该新建、优化还是重做,最后生成一份可执行的 /make-plan 方案。
howto.when: 当你说出「audit this design」这类审计指令,或要求按 Rams 原则评价界面并给出后续方案时触发。常规代码审查、纯文案修改不会用它。

say.text: 按迪特·拉姆斯的十条好设计原则,审计这个设计。
say.note: Claude 会对每条原则打分并附证据。

say.text: 检查这个界面是否符合 Rams 原则,然后给我改进计划。
say.note: 适合先提供截图、链接或仓库路径。

say.text: 这个组件按 Rams 原则该优化还是重做?
say.note: 会先给出「新建/优化/重做」结论。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a design audit, Claude scores the work 0–3 on Dieter Rams' ten principles with evidence, decides NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN, writes audit files, and produces a runnable /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design" or similar, ask to check a UI against Rams, or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan. Not used for routine code reviews or pure copy edits.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Dieter Rams' ten principles.
say_en.note: Each principle gets a score and evidence.

say_en.text: Check this UI against Rams and propose an improvement plan.
say_en.note: Works best with a screenshot, URL, or repo.

say_en.text: Should this component be refined or redesigned per Rams?
